description: The design-source render oracle wiring (exit criterion E7, guardrail G-11). Per frame the oracle imports the committed Figma fixture (corpus/figma-fixtures/<name>.json), compiles it through dashc's compile_figma (Profile::Core), loads and re-solves it with the TaffySolver — running the typesetter measure seam so TEXT nodes size to their shaped extent — renders the committed scene with the Skia reference painter (text painted from a GlyphRunTable staged over the committed Noto atlases, story #303), and diffs that fresh render against the committed Figma design-source PNG (Figma's REST GET /images export) within the frame's per-rule tolerance band. The reference is OUR render of the imported fixture, not a pre-committed corpus golden — so the diff measures the reference painter against Figma's own render of the same scene at the same size. The harness and the bands live in goldens/tooling/src/oracle.rs; the diff runs in goldens/tooling/tests/render_oracle.rs (the_reference_renders_match_their_design_source), un-gated because it is hermetic (committed fixture + committed design source + in-process compile_figma, no network) and fast. A frame is captured by setting its figmaFileKey and figmaNodeId and running `deno task oracle-capture` (importers/figma); that step downloads Figma's GET /images render into design-source/<frame>.png and flips the frame's designSource and status to captured.

gate.reason: The oracle now measures 6 of 7 frames, each within its band. The two layout frames (v08-wrap 0.000%, v08-grid-spans 0.116%, aa-edge) plus the four fixtures authored by the fixture-author plugin (#304) and captured: v08-drop-shadow (0.022%) and v08-inner-shadow (0.000%) on blur-falloff, and v05-text-latin (0.033%) and v06-text-arabic (1.405%) on msdf-text. The text frames render through the text render path (#303) in the committed Noto fonts, so each measures the reference painter against Figma's render of the same font. The Arabic frame caught a real line-height bug — the typesetter took a line's height from the cascade's primary font — fixed in #314, which brought it from 3.300% to 1.405%. Only v08-baseline stays pending: it authors its Latin leaves in 'Inter', which the committed corpus does not provide, so rendered in Noto Sans its HUG root measures 621x160 against Figma's 608x160 (Noto Sans advances are wider than Inter) — a dimension mismatch that cannot be diffed. It becomes measurable once it renders in its authored font (a committed Inter atlas, or a Noto-authored re-capture of the node). No design source is fabricated or stood in for by the project's own render — that is the self-oracle failure G-11 forbids — so v08-baseline's figmaFileKey, figmaNodeId, and designSource stay null and its status stays pending-265. The v0.9 exit gate (#49) flips E7 from partial to met once v08-baseline is measured too.

frames.note: Layout frame (E3 wrap; story #46). The committed fixture imports and renders to 420x184 and diffs within the aa-edge band against Figma's GET /images render of node 1:10. Hard rect edges — the aa-edge band.

Layout frame (E3 grid spans; story #46). The committed fixture imports and renders to 720x480 and diffs within the aa-edge band against Figma's GET /images render of node 1:11. The five structural cells (span/fill/minmax/fixed placement and positions) match the export pixel-exact. The sixth cell is a 'hug me' TEXT leaf: with the text render path wired (story #303) its HUG box sizes to the shaped text (no longer collapsing to its padding box), so the grid solves as Figma laid it out and no region is excluded. The whole 720x480 frame diffs 401 px (0.116%) — the residual is the Latin glyph-shape substitution (the fixture authors 'Inter', which the committed corpus does not provide, so the oracle renders it in Noto Sans; the arabic node in v08-baseline is faithful because its family is committed) plus MSDF glyph edges, well within the 2% aa-edge budget. Hard rect edges — the aa-edge band.

PENDING — font gap, not the render path. The text render path is wired (story #303), but this fixture authors its Latin leaves in 'Inter' (Regular and Bold), which the committed corpus does not provide, so the oracle renders them in Noto Sans. The root frame is HUG-width, driven by those Latin advances: our render measures 621x160 against Figma's 608x160 (Noto Sans is wider than Inter), a dimension mismatch that fails before any pixel diff — a faithful design source cannot be measured against a substituted font. Its Figma node is R1S4QqZtT54WVcYcFFuQoD / 1:2 (the arabic leaf, family 'Noto Sans Arabic', IS committed and would render faithfully); capture becomes valid once the frame renders in its authored font — a committed Inter atlas, or a Noto-authored re-capture of the node. The faithful text-fidelity frames are v05-text-latin and v06-text-arabic, authored in the committed fonts. E3 baseline case (story #46) — the aa-edge band.

Soft drop shadow (story #45; fixture authored by the fixture-author drop-shadow command, #304). One 40x40 rounded card with a DROP_SHADOW (offset y=4, blur 6, spread 0, black alpha 0.55) centered in a 96x96 light frame, lowering clean under Profile::Core. The committed fixture imports and renders to 96x96 and diffs 2/9216 px (0.022%) against Figma's GET /images render of node 1:2 — within the blur-falloff band. This is the first real measurement of the sigma = blur/2 mapping (G-1, docs/decisions/effects-vocabulary-shadows.md) against Figma: near-pixel-exact confirms it. The blur-falloff band.

Soft inner shadow (story #45; fixture authored by the fixture-author inner-shadow command, #304). One 40x40 rounded card with an INNER_SHADOW (offset 0, blur 6, spread 0, black alpha 0.55) centered in a 96x96 light frame, lowering clean under Profile::Core. The committed fixture imports and renders to 96x96 and diffs 0/9216 px (0.000%) against Figma's GET /images render of node 1:2 — pixel-exact, within the blur-falloff band. Same sigma = blur/2 pinning as the drop shadow. The blur-falloff band.

Arabic RTL text as MSDF atlas quads (E2; fixture authored by the fixture-author text-arabic command, #304). A banner, a harakat word, and an Arabic-Indic numeral readout, all Noto Sans Arabic Regular (the committed corpus/atlas/arabic font). The committed fixture imports and renders to 520x240 and diffs 1753/124800 px (1.405%) against Figma's GET /images render of node 1:2 — within the msdf-text band. This frame CAUGHT a real bug the self-oracle goldens missed: before story #314 the diff was 3.300% (just over the band) because the typesetter took a line's height from the cascade's primary (Latin) font, so the stacked Arabic lines were measured too short and drifted; #314 derives line height per line from the fonts that shaped it, bringing this to 1.405%. The residual is fine glyph-edge and line-metric difference vs Figma's raster, well within budget. The msdf-text band.

Latin text as MSDF atlas quads (fixture authored by the fixture-author text-latin command, #304). 'Hello dashscene' (28) and '88 mph' (44), both Noto Sans Regular — the committed corpus/atlas/ascii font, so the oracle measures the reference painter against Figma's render of the SAME font, not a substitution. The committed fixture imports and renders to 480x200 and diffs 32/96000 px (0.033%) against Figma's GET /images render of node 1:2 — near-pixel-exact, deep inside the msdf-text band. Confirms the msdf-text band and the text render path (#303). The msdf-text band.
